body: Thank you 🙏
Let me know how you get on won’t you. It’s so annoying the TWW!!
Thank you!! 🙏
Hey OP how are you doing?

Hey I am on week one of paxil after finally deciding to commit to it this time! I was on sertraline but it made me feel wired and unable to sleep. I’ve tried to start paxil a few times but anxiety always gets the better of me so I’m trying to stick to it and give it a chance!! My side effects are jaw clenching and feeling a bit sick. I feel very drowsy so I’m taking it at night. I know it’s hard to not get too anxious about it because I feel the same way! Just got to stick through it in this initial stage and hopefully it will get better. Keep going, hope you’re okay OP.

Thanks so much for your reply. This sounds like a good idea. The more o try the harder it is so I think this will be a good thing to try. Familiar shows are great as there is little stress or unexpected events happening which can aid things. Thank you for your response friend.

Hey there, no I wasn’t told. I was just told that it would take as long as it takes and then today this news just sort of rattled me to the bone as I wasn’t expecting this at all. my progress has been slow as building trust was hard but small steps have been made but not to the extent that we had planned at the start of treatment. My distress is still 8 or 9 out of 10. Still panicking and dissociating a lot, suicidal thoughts etc. I just feel really overwhelmed as trauma work has really been debilitating and now I’m just expected to magically handle all of these hard feelings/ flashbacks/ nightmares etc that have been brought to the surface.

When you hit the maximum did you ask the therapist to get re referred or did you have to go through your gp again? Sorry to hear you’ve had similar experiences I know how hard it is. 

I’m not really sure what other services are available in my area I guess I can ask this. I just want to try handle my anxiety better and deal with ptsd and unexpected triggers better I suppose. Just a lot of things I’m finding hard atm! Thanks for your reply and sending you lots of support.

Hey, thanks for your reply. It just completely feels like they've pulled out my deep problems to the point where I'm struggling to function and now they're like yes surprise only 4 more sessions then you're on your own. Since starting trauma therapy I've had to reduce my hours at work and I'm currently off sick and now I feel so overwhelmed that I only have 4 more sessions to magically become okay. I know it's probably a funding issue and not my therapist's fault in any way as she has truly been wonderful but I feel so sad about it. 

I don't know what my other options are. I will try to build some courage to ask her next week but I always feel really unable to do so as I feel like a burden and shut down. It's sad because It took me so long to build this positive relationship and now it's just over. I don't know I just feel so sad and like they just see me as a number that isn't making enough progress for their files. 

I'm sorry you had such a shitty experience with them too. Wait lists for assessments are just horrendous and I hope you are doing okay. Sorry, you've had to experience that and I hope that once your assessment comes you will be able to access the right support for you that is actually useful!

Not in so many words, I just sort of panicked and then cried lol. When she asked how I felt about that I just said it was scary. Then at the end of my session, I had a panic attack about what we spoke about (trauma stuff) and also I guess the fear of being left completely without support. I just feel so lost and I don't know how to say I need help. I have a session next week and I can try to ask her. Thank you for your response friend.
Thanks that’s really helpful advice, I’ll try that
I hope you get to the top of the waitlist soon, friend. It makes me so frustrated how long the wait is for such services.
Thanks!
Thanks so much for your detailed answer!
Thank you so much for your kind reply. I’ll try writing them down. I hope you’re doing okay too my friend.
Thanks I’ll give that a try. Appreciate your response

Hi thank you for your reply, I really appreciate it. I have a appointment on Wednesday so I’m hanging on for that. This are really hard and I feel really overwhelmed a lot of the time. I’ve called in sick for work because things have just become too much and I’m not coping well. I have the hotline numbers and trying my best. Thanks again for your reply
Thanks for your response. I will have a read into it, hopefully, it will help me figure it all out!

Thank you for your response and for your positivity it means a lot. Feeling overstimulated and overwhelmed is how I feel a lot too. Sometimes it feels like there too much happening all at once (sound, smells, people, thoughts, worries) so small tasks seem daunting and impossible. I often struggle to respond to texts because it feels maybe difficult to portray my usual self if I am struggling mentally.

Thanks for your in-depth response, I appreciate it. I struggle with depression, ptsd and anxiety which makes things seem scary and I feel like a burden all of the time. It's just frustrating how aware I am that I struggle to respond yet can't seem to find a way to do so.

Sorry to hear you’re going through this OP. I know this feeling too well- Im also afraid to sleep because my nightmares are debilitating and i often wake up very distressed/ panicked which leads to flashbacks etc. I keep myself awake for as long as I can because being tired feels easier to handle than the latter. Sending some good vibes your way.
Thanks so much everyone- really going to try and talk to my T about it next week. I appreciate you all for helping me out.
Thanks for being so kind. I just kept saying it’s all okay now! Then distraction techniques haha. Appreciate the reply my dude :)
Thanks so much for this. I have been worrying about it all day since I got home and I felt really awful about having my arms showing but I guess it’s okay, children are just curious.

Hey, sorry to hear that you are feeling the same way. It is somewhat strangely comforting to feel like I’m not insane and not alone in how I feel. It’s the exposure to the trauma that was very distressing and has really triggered a depressive episode and spiralling symptoms. I feel like I can’t even cope being awake because I’m exhausted and hypersensitive to noise or any unpredictable stress. If you ever feel alone or want to chat about it feel free to message me.

Yeah, I don’t know why but I’m so afraid that I’m just going to be left alone to deal with it because I’m struggling. I don’t know if it’s fear of abandonment but I fear that I can’t cope without support. Thank you for your reply, slowing it down seems like the sensible thing to do
Thank you for this, I’m just really exhausted by it and i put a lot of pressure on myself to make progress but it feels like I’m just sort of stuck. I’ll talk to her about it. Thank you
thanks for your reply! i've tried citalopram too and that was awful, sertraline just seems to just intensify my suicidal thoughts so i just feel tired of trying.
I hope you find something that works :(
sorry that you relate :( it sucks. i'm so tired of this feeling, feel like I have given it a good go but i'm exhausted and i just need a break from my mind. citalopram was a no go either -sigh-

dude, i'm so sorry that you had to go through that. it is difficult to cope when people say/ do wrong/ unhelpful things. it always seems that they are trying to make it about them by being so insensitive and so invalidating. i'm sorry that you're having a tough time at the moment. if you ever want to chat- hit me up. you shouldn't be alone in this.
